cases.title: With ignoring switched on, CDCHECKIGNORE ignores finding 1 for Engineer's judgement, says it stays hidden until the pit, pipe or rule value changes, and the Unignore list then holds it
cases.plan_item: UX-DI-03 ignored finding stays ignored (top-40 item 25), switch ON half; R10 is the OFF half
cases.expected: CDCHECKIGNORE (Enter for Ignore, 1, 3 for Engineer's judgement, Enter for no note) prints '[CE] Ignored:' and 'It stays hidden until the pit, the pipe or the rule value changes.' and never 'Ignoring a finding is switched off'. CDCHECKIGNORE Unignore then lists one ignored finding marked '(Engineer's judgement'; Esc at its number prompt leaves it ignored; no command is left waiting.
cases.why_not_unit: The finding list comes from the real drawing and the ignore is written into the live drawing's project record; only the live command shows what the drafter sees.
not_automated: 'Until something changes' (an edit to the pit or pipe the finding names brings it back, 'Asked again: ...' in the palette) is not driven: the subject of finding 1 is not known before the run and the runner cannot pick it out of a line. Recorded only.
The Undo half (BUG-CDCHECKIGNORE-UNDO-C60: list again, Esc, then U) is not driven.
The CDCHECKS ' · 1 ignored' header needs checks.checksCommandEnabled as well; not used here.
